meta.title: Ayatcollections demo store
meta.description: WordPress + WooCommerce with the Ayatcollections theme and 8 sample products.
meta.author: zubaimu21-wq

steps.data:
<?php
// Demo environment only: run background jobs inline instead of loopback requests.
add_filter('action_scheduler_allow_async_request_runner', '__return_false');
// Show the store as customers see it (admin is still available at /wp-admin/).
add_filter('show_admin_bar', '__return_false');

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once get_template_directory() . '/inc/sample-import.php';
ayat_run_setup( array( 'products' => true, 'pages' => true, 'store' => true, 'permalinks' => true, 'noindex' => true ) );
for ( $i = 0; $i < 8; $i++ ) { ayat_import_product( $i ); }
update_option( 'woocommerce_hold_stock_minutes', '' );
set_theme_mod( 'ayat_instagram', 'https://www.instagram.com/' );
set_theme_mod( 'ayat_facebook', 'https://www.facebook.com/' );
set_theme_mod( 'ayat_youtube', 'https://www.youtube.com/' );
flush_rewrite_rules();
